problems.problem:
Unusual orbital trajectories

Prologue: Solving orbits in celestial mechanics can sometimes lead to interesting results. In this problem we look at one particular such solution.

Statement: Imagine a hypothetical solar system containing only the Sun, the Earth and the Moon orbiting the Earth. The individual masses are $M_S$ for the Sun, $M_Z$ for the Earth and $M_M$ for the Moon.

Constants and laws:

Ratio of the Earth–Moon distance to the Sun–Earth distance: $r_M = \frac{7}{45}\,r_Z$

Ratio of the orbital period of the Moon (around the Earth) to that of the Earth: $T_M = \frac{1}{3}\,T_Z$

Condition of the problem: $M_S \gg M_Z \gg M_M$

Binomial approximation: $(1 \pm x)^a \approx 1 \pm a x \;;\quad a \in \mathbb{Q},\ x \ll 1$

Tasks:

(a) Verify that for the given input parameters the condition of the problem (on the masses) still holds. Think about how the double inequality $M_S \gg M_Z \gg M_M$ should be verified. Hint: "$\gg$" may be taken to mean that one number is at least an order of magnitude larger than the other.

(b) Derive the expression for the radius of the Hill sphere around the Earth and check whether the Moon lies inside it. Try placing a test particle on the edge of the Hill sphere around the Earth.

(c) Draw the shape of the Moon's orbit in the reference frame of the Sun. It need not be an exact plot on graph paper, but try to draw it as well as you can. At least 8 points of the trajectory must be plotted. What shape does the trajectory resemble?
problems.problem_orig:
Netradičné orbitálne dráhy

Prológ: Riešenie dráh v nebeskej mechanike môže niekedy viesť k zaujímavým výsledkom. V tejto úlohe sa pozrieme práve na jedno konkrétne riešenie.

Zadanie: Predstavte si hypotetickú slnečnú sústavu kde je iba Slnka, Zem a Mesiac obiehajúci okolo Zeme. Jednotlivé hmotnosti sú $M_S$ pre Slnko, $M_Z$ pre Zem a $M_M$ pre Mesiac.

Koštanty a zákony:

Vzdialenosť Zem-Mesiac ku Slnko-Zem: $r_M = \frac{7}{45}\,r_Z$

Obežná perióda Mesiaca ku Zeme: $T_M = \frac{1}{3}\,T_Z$

Podmienka úlohy: $M_S \gg M_Z \gg M_M$

Binomická aproximácia: $(1 \pm x)^a \approx 1 \pm a x \;;\quad a \in \mathbb{Q},\ x \ll 1$

Úlohy:

(a) Overte, že pre dané vstupné parametre stále platí podmienka úlohy (na hmotnosti). Zamyslite sa, ako je potrebné overiť dvojitú nerovnicu $M_S \gg M_Z \gg M_M$. Hint: za $\gg$ sa dá považovať ak je jedno číslo aspoň o rád väčšie ako druhé.

(b) Odvoďte vzťah pre polomer Hillovej sféry okolo zeme a overte či sa Mesiac v nej nachádza. Pokúste sa umiestniť testovaciu časticu na hranu Hillovej sféry okolo Zeme.

(c) Nakreslite tvar orbity Mesiaca vo vzťažnej sústave Slnka. Nemusí to byť presné grafovanie na milimetrový papier ale pokúste sa o čo najlepšie rysovanie. Minimálne 8 bodov dráhy je potrebné vyniesť. K akému tvaru sa daná dráha podobá?

problems.problem:
JWST

The James Webb Space Telescope is the largest space telescope. It has a mass $m = 6160$ kg and a mirror of diameter $D = 6.5$ m. It specialises in observations in the infrared part of the spectrum at wavelengths from $\lambda_{\min} = 600$ nm to $\lambda_{\max} = 28\,300$ nm. It was launched at the end of 2021 and after a month settled on an orbit that moves in the vicinity of the Lagrange point L2. This means that it keeps its position relative to the Earth.

Assume that the Earth orbits the Sun on an elliptical orbit with semi-major axis $a = 149.6\cdot10^{9}$ m and eccentricity $e = 0.0167$. The position of the point L2 relative to the Earth is $d_P = 1.48\cdot10^{9}$ m at perihelion and $d_A = 1.53\cdot10^{9}$ m at aphelion (the point lies on the Sun – Earth line, on the side away from the Sun). The Moon orbits the Earth on an elliptical orbit inclined to the ecliptic by $i = 5.145^\circ$. Its semi-major axis is $a_{\mathrm{Moon}} = 384.4\cdot10^{6}$ m and its eccentricity $e_{\mathrm{Moon}} = 0.0549$.

Mass of the Sun: $M_\odot = 1.989\cdot10^{30}$ kg
Mass of the Earth: $M_\oplus = 5.974\cdot10^{24}$ kg
Gravitational constant: $G = 6.674\cdot10^{-11}\ \mathrm{m^3\,kg^{-1}\,s^{-2}}$

Radius of the Sun: $R_\odot = 695.5\cdot10^{6}$ m
Radius of the Earth: $R_\oplus = 6.378\cdot10^{6}$ m
Radius of the Moon: $R_{\mathrm{Moon}} = 1.738\cdot10^{6}$ m

Tasks:

(a) To what distance from the Earth does the Earth's umbra extend at perihelion and at aphelion? Can JWST observe a total solar eclipse (assuming it is exactly at L2)?

(b) JWST uses solar power, so it would be a problem if it entered even the Earth's penumbra. What is the half-width of the Earth's penumbra at the point L2? In other words: how far from the Sun – Earth – L2 line (at the point L2) does the Earth's penumbra extend? Compute it for the Earth at perihelion and at aphelion. Hint: JWST is in the Earth's penumbra if, from its point of view, it observes a partial eclipse of the Sun by the Earth.

(c) At what minimum distance from the point L2 (in the direction perpendicular to the Sun – Earth – L2 line) must JWST orbit in order to avoid the Moon's penumbra as well? Hint: compute the case of the Earth at perihelion.

(d) How many times more photons per second does JWST collect than the human eye when observing a distant point object radiating monochromatically at $\lambda_{\min}$? The diameter of the human eye (pupil) is $D_{\mathrm{eye}} = 4$ mm and its quantum efficiency (at $\lambda_{\min}$) is $\eta_{\mathrm{eye}} = 0.1$. The atmospheric extinction (for the given object) is 0.3 mag. The quantum efficiency of JWST (at $\lambda_{\min}$) is $\eta = 0.7$.

(e) What is the smallest distance between two points on the Moon that JWST can (at some time) resolve? (Assume that it is exactly at L2.)

Note: The tasks do not depend on each other; you need not solve them in order. Each task (a, b, c, …) is worth the same (20 points).
problems.problem_orig:
JWST

Ďalekohľad Jamesa Webba je najväčší vesmírny teleskop. Má hmotnosť $m = 6\,160$ kg a zrkadlo s priemerom $D = 6{,}5$ m. Špecializuje sa na pozorovanie v infračervenej oblasti spektra na vlnových dĺžkach od $\lambda_{\min} = 600$ nm do $\lambda_{\max} = 28\,300$ nm. Bol vypustený koncom roku 2021 a po mesiaci sa usadil na dráhu, ktorá sa pohybuje v blízkosti Lagrangeovho bodu L2. To znamená, že si voči Zemi zachováva relatívnu polohu.

Uvažujte, že Zem obieha okolo Slnka po eliptickej dráhe s veľkou polosou $a = 149{,}6\cdot10^{9}$ m a excentricitou $e = 0{,}0167$. Relatívna poloha bodu L2 voči Zemi je v perihéliu $d_P = 1{,}48\cdot10^{9}$ m a v aféliu $d_A = 1{,}53\cdot10^{9}$ m (pričom leží na priamke Slnko – Zem smerom od Slnka). Okolo Zeme obieha Mesiac po eliptickej dráhe, ktorá je sklopená voči ekliptike o $i = 5{,}145^\circ$. Veľká polos je $a_{☾} = 384{,}4\cdot10^{6}$ m a excentricita $e_{☾} = 0{,}0549$.

Hmotnosť Slnka: $M_\odot = 1{,}989\cdot10^{30}$ kg
Hmotnosť Zeme: $M_\oplus = 5{,}974\cdot10^{24}$ kg
Gravitačná konštanta: $G = 6{,}674\cdot10^{-11}\ \mathrm{m^3\,kg^{-1}\,s^{-2}}$

Polomer Slnka: $R_\odot = 695{,}5\cdot10^{6}$ m
Polomer Zeme: $R_\oplus = 6{,}378\cdot10^{6}$ m
Polomer Mesiaca: $R_{☾} = 1{,}738\cdot10^{6}$ m

Úlohy:

(a) Do akej vzdialenosti od Zeme siaha úplný tieň Zeme v perihéliu a aféliu? Môže JWST pozorovať úplne zatmenie Slnka (za predpokladu, že sa nachádza presne v L2)?

(b) JWST využíva solárnu energiu, preto by vadilo ak by vstúpil aj do polotieňa Zeme. Aká je pološírka polotieňu Zeme v bode L2? Inými slovami: ako ďaleko od priamky Slnko – Zem – L2 (v bode L2) siaha polotieň Zeme? Vypočítajte pre Zem v perihéliu aj aféliu. Hint: JWST je v polotieni Zeme ak z jeho pohľadu pozoruje čiastočné zatmenie Slnka Zemou.

(c) V akej najmenšej vzdialenosti od bodu L2 (v smere kolmo na priamku Slnko – Zem – L2) musí JWST obiehať, aby sa vyhol aj polotieňu Mesiaca? Hint: počítajte prípad pre Zem v perihéliu.

(d) Koľkokrát viacej fotónov zachytí za sekundu JWST oproti ľudskému oku pri pozorovaní vzdialeného bodového objektu vyžarujúceho monochromaticky na $\lambda_{\min}$? Priemer ľudského oka (pupily) je $D_{\mathrm{oko}} = 4$ mm a kvantová účinnosť (pre $\lambda_{\min}$) je $\eta_{\mathrm{oko}} = 0{,}1$. Extinkcia atmosféry (pre daný objekt) je 0,3 mag. Kvantová účinnosť JWST (pre $\lambda_{\min}$) je $\eta = 0{,}7$.

(e) Aká je najmenšia vzdialenosť dvoch bodov na Mesiaci, ktoré vie JWST (niekedy) rozlíšiť? (Predpokladajte, že sa nachádza presne v L2)

Poznámka: Úlohy na seba nenadväzujú, nemusíte ich počítať zaradom. Každá úloha (a,b,c,...) je hodnotená rovnako (za 20 bodov).

problems.problem:
Shorter problems

3.1 On interstellar absorption

Between a star with colour index $(B-V)_0 = 0$ and the Earth there is a cloud of interstellar dust that absorbs part of the star's light. The absorption depends on wavelength: the longer the wavelength, the smaller the absorption. Because of the absorption, a different value of the colour index $(B-V)$ is observed on the Earth. Is this observed value positive or negative? The mean wavelength in the B filter is 442 nm and in the V filter 540 nm.

3.2 On the Universe

Assuming that the scale factor $a$ is proportional to $t^{2/3}$, where $t$ is the age of the Universe, compute in $\mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$ the densities of normal matter, dark matter and dark energy at the time when the age of the Universe was 8 billion years. The present density parameter of normal matter is $\Omega_{N,0} = 0.049$, of dark matter $\Omega_{DM,0} = 0.259$ and of dark energy $\Omega_{DE,0} = 0.691$. The density parameter is computed as $\Omega = \frac{\rho}{\rho_C}$, where the critical density of the Universe is $\rho_C = 9\cdot10^{-27}\ \mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$. The density of dark energy does not depend on the scale factor $a$. The Universe is currently approximately 14 billion years old.

problems.problem:
Planetary transit

One of the rare phenomena in the Solar System are transits of planets across the solar disc. Of all combinations of planets from which we observe the phenomenon and planets that pass in front of the Sun, the transit of Uranus across the solar disc observed from Neptune is the rarest. Assume that the orbits of Uranus and Neptune are circular and that their other parameters are given by the data in the table. Further, assume that we observe this transit from the Earth. The radius of the Sun is 695 700 km.

$$\begin{array}{l|c|c|c|c}
 & \text{semi-major axis} & \text{orbital inclination} & \text{longitude of the ascending node} & \text{planet radius} \\
\hline
\text{Uranus} & 19.19\ \text{au} & 0.773^\circ & 74.0^\circ & 25\,360\ \text{km} \\
\text{Neptune} & 30.07\ \text{au} & 1.770^\circ & 131.8^\circ & 24\,620\ \text{km}
\end{array}$$

Tasks:

1. In which constellation will the planets be during the transit?

2. By how many magnitudes does Neptune dim?

3. What is the longest possible duration of the total phase of the transit? What is the longest possible duration of the transit between the 1st and 4th contacts?

Planetárny tranzit

Jedným zo zriedkavých javov v Slnečnej sústave sú prechody planét popred slnečný disk. Zo všetkých kombinácií planét, z ktorých jav pozorujeme, a planét, ktoré popred Slnko prechádzajú, je prechod Uránu popred slnečný disk pozorovaný z Neptúnu ten najzriedkavejší. Uvažujte, že dráhy Uránu a Neptúna sú kruhové a ich ostatné parametre sú dané údajmi v tabuľke. Ďalej uvažujme, že tento tranzit pozorujeme zo Zeme. Polomer Slnka je 695 700 km.

$$\begin{array}{l|c|c|c|c}
 & \text{veľká poloos} & \text{sklon dráhy} & \text{dĺžka výstupného uzla} & \text{polomer planéty} \\
\hline
\text{Urán} & 19{,}19\ \text{au} & 0{,}773^\circ & 74{,}0^\circ & 25\,360\ \text{km} \\
\text{Neptún} & 30{,}07\ \text{au} & 1{,}770^\circ & 131{,}8^\circ & 24\,620\ \text{km}

Úlohy:

1. V akom súhvezdí sa budú planéty počas prechodu nachádzať?

2. O koľko magnitúd Neptún potemnie?

3. Ako najdlhšie môže trvať úplná fáza tranzitu? Ako najdlhšie môže trvať tranzit medzi 1. a 4. kontaktom?

problems.problem:
"Houston, we have a problem" (60 points)

The Apollo 13 module is moving at a distance of 1000 km from the Earth's surface with speed $v = 9.5\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$, and at this moment the angle between the trajectory of Apollo and the line joining Apollo and the Earth is $35^\circ$.

(a) [50 points] Compute the angle of entry into the atmosphere at a height of 100 km above the Earth's surface. Above the height of 100 km, consider the drag of the atmosphere negligible.

(b) [5 points] What would happen if the entry angle into the atmosphere were too small and, conversely, if it were too large?

(c) [5 points] What effects act on the module after it enters the atmosphere?

Hint: You may find useful the formula for the magnitude of the cross product $|\vec{a}\times\vec{b}| = |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\sin\theta$, where $\theta$ is the angle between the vectors $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$.

problems.problem:
Inclined (60 points)

Let us imagine a hypothetical situation. You are observing a binary star system. You know the mass of the primary star $M_1 = 4.5\,M_\odot$ and the mass of the secondary star $M_2 = 1.2\,M_\odot$. You see that the secondary star traces an ellipse on the night sky relative to the primary star, with period $T = 13.2$ years. This is shown schematically in Figure T2.1, where the angular size of the semi-major axis is $q'' = 8.4''$ and the angular size of the semi-minor axis is $p'' = 2.6''$. Assume that the system is at a distance $d = 1$ pc.

Figure T2.1: Illustrative scheme of the observed relative orbit with the primary star held fixed.

Compute
(a) [10 points] the possible values of the semi-major axis of the system,
(b) [25 points] the possible values of the inclination of the system,
(c) [25 points] the possible values of the eccentricity of the system.

Help: the inclination of the system is the angle between the line of sight and the normal to the orbital plane.

Note: in reality the nearest star to the Sun is at a distance greater than 1 pc (specifically 1.3 pc), so this is really a purely hypothetical situation.

problems.problem:
The Great American Eclipse II (60 points)

A group of astronomers travelled to the USA for the total solar eclipse that took place on 8 April 2024. On the way to the USA they flew from Vienna to Chicago, and back to Europe they flew from Houston to Frankfurt. They wondered whether on at least one of the flights they would fly over Greenland. They found out in advance that the southernmost tip of Greenland is at latitude $\varphi_G = 59^\circ 46'$ N.

For both flights decide whether the aircraft gets far enough north to be able to fly over Greenland. Support your claim by a calculation. Assume that the aircraft flew exactly along great circles.

The coordinates of the airports are:
- Vienna: $\varphi_V = 48^\circ 7'$ N, $\lambda_V = 16^\circ 34'$ E,
- Chicago: $\varphi_C = 41^\circ 59'$ N, $\lambda_C = 87^\circ 54'$ W,
- Houston: $\varphi_H = 29^\circ 59'$ N, $\lambda_H = 95^\circ 20'$ W,
- Frankfurt: $\varphi_F = 50^\circ 2'$ N, $\lambda_F = 8^\circ 34'$ E.

Hint: you may find useful the fact that the meridian passing through the northernmost point of the aircraft's path is perpendicular to this path.

problems.problem:
Extinction of the dinosaurs (60 points)

In this problem the life of a dinosaur is at stake (Fig. T4.1), because at the end of the Mesozoic a massive asteroid collided with the Earth. As a result of this dramatic collision almost all land animals larger than a corgi died out. This year, too, sees the anniversary of this momentous cosmic event, so let us commemorate it worthily, at least in this problem.

Assume that a spherical asteroid ($D = 10$ km) made of roughly the same material as the Earth was, before approaching the Earth, on a parabolic orbit around the Sun, and that it collided with the Earth in a direction perpendicular to its own velocity vector around the Sun. Assume that as a result of the impact all its kinetic energy was converted into heat.

(a) [20 points] Compute the approximate amount of heat released.

The immensely large amount of heat released caused worldwide forest fires. According to scientists, about $3\cdot10^{13}$ kg of carbon in the form of soot was released into the atmosphere. Assume that the particles spread homogeneously in the atmosphere above the surface up to a height of 20 km. Further assume that the soot particles are spherical with a physical radius of 3000 nm, and that their effective radius for interaction with radiation is the same as the physical radius. The density of soot is about $2\ \mathrm{g\,cm^{-3}}$.

(b) [30 points] What fraction of solar radiation passes through the soot layer undisturbed down to the Earth's surface? Express it as a percentage and also by means of the new apparent magnitude of the Sun. If the lower limit for photosynthesis is about 1% of the usual radiation, will vegetation, and with it the whole ecosystem (Fig. T4.1), survive this event?

(c) [10 points] If all the soot particles were larger/smaller, how would the result change, if all other parameters remained the same? No detailed calculations are needed, only an intuitive logical argument; you can solve this part by reasoning even if you did not do (b).

Help, mainly for part (b)
For the attenuation of radiation $I$ due to its scattering in an optically thick medium along the $x$ axis, the decreasing exponential relation holds:
$$I(x) = I_0\,e^{-n S_{\mathrm{eff}}\,x}\,. \qquad \text{(T4.1)}$$
Here $S_{\mathrm{eff}}$ is the effective cross-section of a particle for interaction with radiation [$\mathrm{m^2}$], $n$ is the number density of particles [$\mathrm{m^{-3}}$], and $I_0$ is the radiant flux density [$\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}}$] before entering the optically thick medium. This equation is also called the Beer–Lambert law.

Uvažujte, že sférický asteroid ($D = 10$ km) z približne rovnakého materiálu ako Zem bol pred priblížením k Zemi na parabolickej dráhe okolo Slnka a so Zemou sa zrazil v smere kolmom na jeho vlastný vektor rýchlosti okolo Slnka. Uvažujte, že sa častice v atmosfére rozprestreli homogénne nad povrchom až do výšky 20 km. Pomôcka, najme k časti (b)
Pre útlm žiarenia $I$ v dôsledku jeho rozptylu v opticky hustom prostredí pozdĺž osi $x$ platí klesajúci exponenciálny vzťah

Tu $S_{\mathrm{eff}}$ je efektívny prierez častice pre interakciu so žiarením [$\mathrm{m^2}$], $n$ je priestorová koncentrácia častíc [$\mathrm{m^{-3}}$], $I_0$ je hustota žiarivého toku [$\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}}$] pred vstupom do opticky hustého prostredia. problems.problem:
Problems of a tidally locked Earth (60 points)

One possible view of why the Earth still keeps its atmosphere is that the typical speed $\bar{v}$ of molecules in the atmosphere is smaller than the escape velocity. The typical speed of a gas molecule is given by the Maxwell–Boltzmann distribution as
$$\bar{v} = \sqrt{\frac{2RT}{M}}\,. \qquad \text{(T5.1)}$$
Here $R$ is the universal gas constant, $T$ is the temperature and $M$ is the mass of the molecule. For the nitrogen molecule $\mathrm{N_2}$ at laboratory temperature $T_0 = 20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ we have $\bar{v}_0 = 422\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$, which is considerably less than the escape velocity $v_{\mathrm{II}}$. The escape velocity is the smallest speed needed to leave the gravitational field of the Earth.

But what would happen if the Earth became tidally locked to the Sun, so that the temperature on its side facing the Sun increased? Neglect heat transfer to the far side.

(a) [25 points] Compute the new temperature on the side of the Earth facing the Sun.

(b) [25 points] Compute the new typical speed of $\mathrm{N_2}$ at the new temperature on the day side. Is such a speed sufficient to escape from the Earth's surface?

(c) [10 points] If you answered (b) in the negative: what temperature must the day side of the Earth reach for the $\mathrm{N_2}$ gas to escape from the Earth's surface?

For a correct solution you will need the value of the solar constant, which gives how much energy per second falls perpendicularly on one square metre of area from the Sun near the Earth. Its value is $k_\odot = 1361\ \mathrm{W\,m^{-2}}$. The second essential piece of information is the formula for the escape velocity
$$v_{\mathrm{II}} = \sqrt{\frac{2GM_\oplus}{R_\oplus}} \approx 11.2\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}\,. \qquad \text{(T5.2)}$$
problems.problem_orig:
Problémy viazanej Zeme (60 b)

Jeden z možných pohľadov na to, prečo si Zem stále drží atmosféru, je, že typická rýchlosť molekúl $\bar{v}$ v atmosfére je menšia ako druhá kozmická rýchlosť. Typická rýchlosť molekuly plynu je daná Maxwell-Boltzmanovým rozdelením ako
$$\bar{v} = \sqrt{\frac{2RT}{M}}\,. \qquad \text{(T5.1)}$$
Kde $R$ je univerzálna plynová konštanta, $T$ je teplota a $M$ je hmotnosť molekuly. Pre molekulu dusíka $\mathrm{N_2}$ pri laboratórnej teplote $T_0 = 20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ máme $\bar{v}_0 = 422\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$, čo je výrazne menej ako druhá kozmická rýchlosť $v_{\mathrm{II}}$. Druhá kozmická rýchlosť je najmenšia potrebná rýchlosť na opustenie gravitačného poľa Zeme.

Čo by sa ale stalo keby Zem získala voči Slnku viazanú rotáciu a tým by sa teplota na jej privrátenej strane ku Slnku zvýšila? Zanedbajte prenos tepla na odvrátenú stranu.

(a) [25 b] Vypočítajte novú teplotu na privrátenej strane Zeme.

(b) [25 b] Vypočítajte novú typickú rýchlosť $\mathrm{N_2}$ pri novej teplote na privrátenej strane. Postačuje takáto rýchlosť na únik z povrchu Zeme?

(c) [10 b] Ak ste odpovedali v časti b) záporne. Akú teplotu musí dosiahnuť privrátená strana Zeme aby plyn $\mathrm{N_2}$ unikol z povrchu Zeme?

K správnemu riešeniu budete potrebovať veľkosť slnečnej konštanty, ktorá udáva koľko energie za sekundu dopadá kolmo na meter štvorcový plochy zo Slnka v blízkosti Zeme. Jej hodnota je $k_\odot = 1361\ \mathrm{W\cdot m^{-2}}$. Druhá podstatná informácia je vzorec na výpočet druhej kozmickej rýchlosti
$$v_{\mathrm{II}} = \sqrt{\frac{2GM_\oplus}{R_\oplus}} \approx 11{,}2\ \mathrm{km\cdot s^{-1}}\,. \qquad \text{(T5.2)}$$

Rýchlostná dátovka (150 b)

Veľkou otázkou v kozmológii je presná hodnota Hubble-Lemaîtrovho parametra $H_0$ (známy aj ako Hubblova konštanta). Ten udáva rýchlosť $v$ zdanlivého vzďaľovania sa vesmírnych objektov, v dôsledku rozpínania vesmíru, v závislosti od ich vzdialenosti $D$,

problems.problem:
Mozart (60 points)

Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, one of the greatest composers of music, was born on 27 January 1756. Several astronomical phenomena occurred in that month, among them a conjunction of Saturn on 21 January.

(a) [30 points] On his fourteenth birthday a friend told him that the previous summer he had observed exactly the same phenomenon, a conjunction of Saturn. He did not remember, however, on which date it was. Help them find out.

(b) [20 points] This interested Mozart, so he decided that he would observe this conjunction himself next time. When will that be? Give the result with the greatest precision that is reasonable.

(c) [10 points] Why will there be time deviations from your result in reality?

Assume that the conjunction of January 1756 occurred, as historical sources state, at 18:49 local zone time, and that the orbital period of Saturn is $10\,757.736\,48$ days. Consider the orbits of the planets circular. Take the orbital period of the Earth as $365.256\,360\,4$ days.

problems.problem:
Exoplanet around a pulsar (48 points)

In practice we know several methods of discovering new exoplanets. The two best known are the transit method and the radial-velocity method. The very first exoplanet, however, was discovered by a different method, the "pulsar timing method". The idea is that if a planet orbits a pulsar (or in principle any star that shows a periodic phenomenon), then because of the planet's orbit around the star the pulses will arrive ahead of time or delayed at regular intervals. The reason for these changes is that during the orbit not only the planet but also the pulsar orbits the common centre of mass. This means that the pulsar is sometimes physically closer to us and sometimes farther away, which corresponds exactly to the pulse arriving earlier or later than we would expect, because the light from the pulsar has to travel a longer or a shorter distance towards us.

In this problem we look at the discovery of the very first exoplanet (system of exoplanets), around the pulsar PSR B 1257+12. The discovery was made by the Polish astronomer A. Wolsczan in 1994. In the problem assume a (typical) pulsar mass $M_{\mathrm{psr}} = 1.4\,M_\odot$.

Attached to the problem is a graph of the time evolution of O – C (Fig. T2.1), i.e. the difference between the observed and the true arrival times of the pulses caused by the planet PSR 1257+12c of mass $m_{\mathrm{p}}$. In the calculation use the approximation $m_{\mathrm{p}} \ll M_{\mathrm{psr}}$, which also means that the pulsar is much closer to the centre of mass than the planet. Find the following parameters of the planet and the pulsar:

(a) [10 points] the orbital period of the planet around the pulsar,

(b) [12 points] the distance of the pulsar from their common centre of mass,

(c) [14 points] the semi-major axis of the planet,

(d) [12 points] the mass of the planet.

problems.problem:
Strange cosmological distances (60 points)

In cosmology there are phenomena that deviate so much from our everyday experience that at first sight they seem paradoxical. One of them concerns the angular size under which we observe objects of the deep Universe. From everyday experience we know that the farther away an object is, the smaller it appears to us, i.e. the smaller its angular size. This fact can be used to determine the distance of an object, provided we know its physical size.

In cosmology, however, it is not so simple. There is a certain distance beyond which the angular diameter of an object starts to increase with increasing distance. This effect can be explained, in a simplified way, as a consequence of the finite speed of light. Light rays coming from a galaxy in the early Universe travelled to us from it for a long time and originate from times when the galaxy was much closer. Because of this we essentially see the galaxy under the angular diameter it had at the time when the rays left it. Because of the expansion of the Universe, however, it is now at a larger distance, which should correspond to a smaller angular diameter than we observe (see the figure).

The particular distance at which this cosmological effect prevails and the angular diameter of objects starts to increase depends on the geometry and on the density of the individual components of the Universe. We shall call the place where this happens the turning point of the angular distance.

To be able to calculate the value of this distance we need two basic equations describing the evolution of the Universe: the Friedmann equation and the deceleration equation.
$$H^2 + \frac{Kc^2}{a^2} = \frac{\Lambda c^2}{3} + \frac{8\pi G}{3}\rho\,, \qquad \text{(T3.1)}$$
$$-2qH^2 + H^2 + \frac{Kc^2}{a^2} = \Lambda c^2 - \frac{8\pi G}{c^2}P\,. \qquad \text{(T3.2)}$$
$H$ is the Hubble–Lemaître parameter, $K$ is the curvature of the Universe, $a$ is the scale factor, $\rho$ is the sum of the densities of matter and radiation, $\Lambda$ is the cosmological constant, $P$ is the radiation pressure and $q$ is the deceleration parameter (a numerical expression of the slowing down of the expansion of the Universe). The curvature is $+1$ for a spherical, $0$ for a flat and $-1$ for a hyperbolic geometry of the Universe.

(a) [10 points] Compute the value of the deceleration parameter for a flat Universe without dark energy, consisting only of matter. Consider these assumptions to hold in all the remaining parts as well.

If we know both the linear (physical) and the angular diameter of an object, we can compute its so-called angular distance $d_{\mathrm{A}}$, i.e. the distance from which we would observe an object of diameter $D$ under the angular diameter $\theta$ if we did not take any cosmological effects into account. In cosmology the angular distance can also be determined from the redshift $z$; under the assumptions given in part (a), the Mattig relation holds for it:
$$d_{\mathrm{A}} = \frac{c}{Hq^2}\cdot\frac{zq + (q-1)\left(\sqrt{2qz+1}-1\right)}{(1+z)^2}\,. \qquad \text{(T3.3)}$$

(b) [30 points] Compute the redshift of the turning point of the angular distance, i.e. of the place at which the angular size of an object starts to increase with increasing distance.

While in classical physics distances determined by different methods are in principle the same, in cosmology this is not so. There are several different definitions of distance, each of which has a different value. For small values of the redshift, however, they are all equal, as we would expect from our everyday experience.

(c) [20 points] Compute the angular distance $d_{\mathrm{A}}$ (in parsecs) for the redshift of the turning point and compare it with the distance that follows from the Hubble law. Which one is larger and by what factor?

Hint: a function of the form $f(x) = A\cdot(x^b - x^c)$ has a maximum at the point $x$ satisfying the equation
$$A\cdot\left(b x^{b-1} - c x^{c-1}\right) = 0\,. \qquad \text{(T3.4)}$$

problems.problem_orig:
Podivné kozmologické vzdialenosti (60 b)

V kozmológii sa vyskytujú javy, ktoré sa natoľko vymykajú našej bežnej skúsenosti, že sa nám na prvý pohľad zdajú až paradoxné. Jeden z nich sa týka aj uhlovej veľkosti, pod akou pozorujeme objekty hlbokého vesmíru. Z našej bežnej skúsenosti vieme, že čím je objekt ďalej, tým sa nám javí menší, teda má menší uhlový rozmer. Tento fakt sa dá využiť na určenie vzdialenosti objektu, za predpokladu, že poznáme jeho fyzický rozmer.

V kozmológii to ale nie je tak jednoduché. Existuje určitá vzdialenosť, od ktorej sa uhlový priemer objektu s pribúdajúcou vzdialenosťou začne zväčšovať. Tento efekt sa dá zjednodušene vysvetliť ako dôsledok konečnej rýchlosti svetla. Lúče svetla pochádzajúce z galaxie z raného vesmíru, k nám od nej cestovali dlhú dobu a pochádzajú z čias, kedy bola galaxia oveľa bližšie. Galaxiu kvôli tomu v podstate vidíme pod uhlovým priemerom, aký mala v čase, keď z nej vyrazili lúče svetla. Kvôli expanzii vesmíru je ale v súčasnosti vo väčšej vzdialenosti, ktorá by mala zodpovedať menšiemu uhlovému priemeru ako pozorujeme (viď obrázok).

Konkrétna vzdialenosť, v ktorej prevládne tento kozmologický efekt a uhlový priemer objektov sa začne zväčšovať, závisí na geometrii a hustote jednotlivých zložiek vesmíru. Miesto, v ktorom k tomu dochádza, nazveme bod obratu uhlovej vzdialenosti.

Na to, aby sme dokázali vypočítať hodnotu tejto vzdialenosti, budeme potrebovať dve základné rovnice popisujúce vývoj vesmíru: Friedmannovu rovnicu a deceleračnú rovnicu.
$$H^2 + \frac{Kc^2}{a^2} = \frac{\Lambda c^2}{3} + \frac{8\pi G}{3}\rho\,, \qquad \text{(T3.1)}$$
$$-2qH^2 + H^2 + \frac{Kc^2}{a^2} = \Lambda c^2 - \frac{8\pi G}{c^2}P\,. \qquad \text{(T3.2)}$$
$H$ je Hubble-Lemaîtreov parameter, $K$ je krivosť vesmíru, $a$ je faktor škály, $\rho$ je súčet hustoty hmoty a žiarenia, $\Lambda$ je kozmologická konštanta, $P$ je tlak žiarenia a $q$ je deceleračný parameter (číselné vyjadrenie spomaľovania rozpínania vesmíru). Hodnota krivosti je $+1$ pre sférickú, $0$ pre plochú a $-1$ pre hyperbolickú geometriu vesmíru.

(a) [10 b] Vypočítajte hodnotu deceleračného parametra pre plochý vesmír bez tmavej energie, ktorý sa skladá iba z hmoty. Tieto predpoklady považujte za pravdivé aj vo všetkých zvyšných podúlohách.

Ak poznáme lineárny (fyzický) aj uhlový priemer objektu, vieme vypočítať jeho tzv. uhlovú vzdialenosť $d_{\mathrm{A}}$ – teda vzdialenosť, z akej by sme objekt s priemerom $D$ pozorovali pod uhlovým priemerom $\theta$, ak by sme neuvažovali žiadne kozmologické efekty. Uhlovú vzdialenosť vieme v kozmológii určiť aj na základe červeného posunu $z$, za predpokladov uvedených v úlohe (a) pre ňu totiž platí Mattigov vzťah:
$$d_{\mathrm{A}} = \frac{c}{Hq^2}\cdot\frac{zq + (q-1)\left(\sqrt{2qz+1}-1\right)}{(1+z)^2}\,. \qquad \text{(T3.3)}$$

(b) [30 b] Vypočítajte červený posun bodu obratu uhlovej vzdialenosti, teda miesta, na ktorom sa uhlový rozmer objektu s narastajúcou vzdialenosťou začne zväčšovať.

Zatiaľ čo v klasickej fyzike vzdialenosti určené rôznymi metódami sú v princípe rovnaké, v kozmológii toto neplatí. Existuje niekoľko rôznych definícií vzdialenosti, pričom každá z nich má inú hodnotu. Pre malé hodnoty červeného posunu sa ale všetky rovnajú, tak ako by sme to čakali podľa našich bežných skúseností.

(c) [20 b] Vypočítajte uhlovú vzdialenosť $d_{\mathrm{A}}$ (v parsekoch) pre červený posun bodu obratu a porovnajte ju so vzdialenosťou, ktorá vychádza z Hubblovho zákona. Ktorá je väčšia a koľkokrát?

Nápoveda: funkcia v tvare $f(x) = A\cdot(x^b - x^c)$ má maximum v bode $x$ spĺňajúcom rovnicu
$$A\cdot\left(b x^{b-1} - c x^{c-1}\right) = 0\,. \qquad \text{(T3.4)}$$

problems.problem:
Stellar evolution (70 points)

Stellar evolution can be divided into three significant stages, each of which is dominated by a certain physical process. All these processes take place on a certain characteristic time scale, which gives us a good estimate of how long the given stage of the star's life lasts.

The nuclear time scale is the time in which a star radiates all the energy it can obtain from nuclear reactions. From theoretical models we know that a star manages to use only 10 % of its hydrogen for nuclear reactions (conversion of hydrogen to helium) before other, faster evolutionary mechanisms begin to dominate. In nuclear reactions only 0.7 % of the rest mass of the nuclei taking part in the reactions is converted into energy.

(a) [15 points] Write the general expression for the nuclear time scale $t_{\mathrm{n}}$ and compute its numerical value for the Sun. For simplicity assume that stars consist of hydrogen only.

The thermal (Kelvin–Helmholtz) time scale is the time in which a star would radiate all its thermal energy, assuming that no nuclear reactions took place. This scale is also a good estimate of the time in which radiation gets from the centre of the star to its surface.

From thermodynamics we know that the thermal (internal) energy of a gas equals the total kinetic energy $E_{\mathrm{k}}$ of the gas particles. Assume that stars have uniformly distributed density and are in virial equilibrium. The gravitational binding energy of such a star is
$$E_{\mathrm{p}} = -\frac{3GM^2}{5R}\,. \qquad \text{(T4.1)}$$

(b) [20 points] Write the general expression for the thermal time scale $t_{\mathrm{t}}$ and compute its numerical value for the Sun.

The dynamical scale is the time in which a star would collapse if no pressure gradient acted against gravity. It is computed as the time of free fall of a particle from the surface to the centre of the star.

You can imagine the free fall from the surface to the centre of the star as motion along a very thin ellipse with the apocentre on the surface and the pericentre at the centre of the star. You may assume that all the mass is concentrated at the centre of the star.

(b) [20 points] Write the general expression for the dynamical time scale $t_{\mathrm{d}}$ and compute its numerical value for the Sun.

(c) [15 points] Rewrite the general expressions for all three time scales in the following form
$$t_{\mathrm{x}} = \left(\frac{R}{R_\odot}\right)^{a}\left(\frac{M}{M_\odot}\right)^{b}\left(\frac{L}{L_\odot}\right)^{c} t_{\mathrm{x}\odot}\,, \qquad \text{(T4.2)}$$
where $t_{\mathrm{x}}$ is the time scale of the star, $\mathrm{x} = \{\mathrm{n}, \mathrm{t}, \mathrm{d}\}$, $t_{\mathrm{x}\odot}$ is the time scale of the Sun, and $R$, $M$ and $L$ are the radius, mass and luminosity of the star. The constants $a$, $b$ and $c$ are different for each time scale.

Hviezdna evolúcia (70 b)

Hviezdna evolúcia sa dá rozdeliť do troch významných etáp, pričom každá z nich je dominovaná určitým fyzikálnym procesom. Všetky tieto procesy prebiehajú na určitej charakteristickej časovej škále, ktorá nám dáva dobrý odhad toho, ako dlho trvá dané štádium života hviezdy.

Nukleárna časová škála je čas, za ktorý hviezda vyžiari všetku energiu, ktorú môže získať z jadrových reakcií. Z teoretických modelov vieme, že hviezda stihne na jadrové reakcie (premenu vodíka na hélium) spotrebovať iba 10 % vodíka predtým, ako začnú prevládať iné, rýchlejšie evolučné mechanizmy. Na energiu sa v jadrových reakciách premení len 0,7 % pokojovej hmotnosti jadier, ktoré sa účastnia reakcií.

(a) [15 b] Napíšte všeobecné vyjadrenie pre nukleárnu časovú škálu $t_{\mathrm{n}}$ a vypočítajte jej číselnú hodnotu pre Slnko. Pre jednoduchosť predpokladajte, že hviezdy sa skladajú iba z vodíka.

Termálna (Kelvinova-Helmholtzova) časová škála je čas, za ktorý by hviezda vyžiarila všetku svoju tepelnú energiu za predpokladu, že by neprebiehali žiadne jadrové reakcie. Táto škála je zároveň dobrým odhadom času, za ktorým sa žiarenie dostane zo stredu hviezdy na jej povrch.

Z termodynamiky vieme, že tepelná (vnútorná) energia plynu sa rovná celkovej kinetickej energii $E_{\mathrm{k}}$ častíc plynu. Predpokladajte, že hviezdy majú rovnomerne rozloženú hustotu a sú vo viriálovej rovnováhe. Gravitačná väzbová energia takejto hviezdy je
$$E_{\mathrm{p}} = -\frac{3GM^2}{5R}\,. \qquad \text{(T4.1)}$$

problems.problem:
I shoot, I shoot and nothing works (70 points)

Nowadays almost all large telescopes use adaptive optics (not to be confused with active optics). Its purpose is to compensate the chaotic motions of the atmosphere (so-called seeing), which would otherwise blur the image. To correct the seeing, however, one needs to know the current disturbance of the atmosphere (measured in arcseconds). A Shack–Hartmann sensor can serve this purpose.

A Shack–Hartmann sensor is basically a very simple instrument. It is nothing but a large CCD sensor onto which an array of lenses arranged in a grid projects the image. This means that each such lens (a small eyepiece) forms, on its own part of the sensor (a "patch"), an image of the star from a different part of the primary mirror. If the optical system is perfect and the influence of the atmosphere on the light is zero, the stars form a point image exactly at the centre of this patch. If, however, the light passes through a non-uniform medium (e.g. the Earth's atmosphere), these star images are shifted. By measuring these shifts we can determine how the light was distorted, and then use the information to correct the image with the help of a tertiary, deformable mirror.

These sensors, however, have their limitations, and one of them is the maximum seeing they are able to correct. This maximum seeing is the moment when one of the lenses already projects the image of the star outside its part of the sensor.

Side length of the sensor: $D = 8$ cm. (T5.1)
Number of pixels on the sensor: $N = 4$ Mpx. (T5.2)
Side length of a patch: $d = 5$ mm. (T5.3)
Focal length of the lenses: $f = 12$ cm. (T5.4)

Fig. T5.1: Drawing of one row of the Shack–Hartmann sensor with all the important parameters marked; their values are given above.

(a) [10 points] How many pixels (denote it $n^2$) fall on one square patch (with a side of $n$ pixels) that is reserved for one eyepiece and thus serves to record the image from one part of the primary mirror? The sensor, as well as the pixels, are square.

(b) [30 points] Compute the maximum correctable seeing in arcseconds, denote it $\Xi$, that the Shack–Hartmann sensor with the parameters given above is able to correct.

(c) [30 points] Compute also the theoretically smallest detectable seeing $\xi$. For simplicity assume that the image of the star is smaller than the size of a pixel, and hence that the light of the star always falls into only one particular pixel. Do not consider any further mathematical processing of the image.

problems.problem_orig:
Snímam, snímam a nič nejde (70 b)

V súčasnosti takmer všetky veľké ďalekohľady využívajú adaptívnu optiku (nezamieňať s aktívnou optikou). Tá má za účel kompenzovať chaotické pohyby atmosféry (tzv. seeing), ktoré by inak spôsobovali rozmazanie obrazu. K oprave seeingu je ale potrebné vedieť, aké je aktuálne narušenie atmosféry (merané v uhlových sekundách). Pre tento účel môže slúžiť Shackov-Hartmanov senzor.

Shackov-Hartmanov senzor je v základoch veľmi jednoduchý prístroj. Nie je to nič iné ako veľký CCD snímač, na ktorý premieta obraz sústava šošoviek usporiadaná do mriežky. Čo znamená, že každá takáto šošovka (malý okulár) vytvára na svojej časti snímača („plôške“) obraz hviezdy z inej časti primárneho zrkadla. Ak je optický systém dokonalý a ovplyvnenie svetla atmosférou nulové, potom hviezdy vytvárajú bodový obraz presne v strede tejto plôšky. Ak však svetlo prechádza cez nerovnomerné prostredie (napr. cez zemskú atmosféru), tieto obrazy hviezd sa posunú. Meraním týchto posunov dokážeme určiť ako sa svetlo skreslilo a následne informáciu vieme využiť na korekciu obrazu za pomoci terciárneho, deformovateľného zrkadla.

Tieto snímače ale majú svoje obmedzenia, a jedno z nich je maximálny seeing, ktorý sú schopné opraviť. Tento maximálny seeing je moment, kedy už niektorá zo šošoviek premieta obraz hviezdy mimo svoju časť snímača.

Počet pixelov na snímači: $N = 4$ Mpx. (T5.2)
Veľkosť strany plôšky: $d = 5$ mm. (T5.3)
Ohnisková vzdialenosť šošoviek: $f = 12$ cm. (T5.4)

problems.problem:
Lyman vs Balmer (80 points)

A talented astrophysicist became very fond of Johann Jakob Balmer during his studies, but took a dislike to Theodore Lyman IV. He therefore decided to create a hypothetical particle, the Košicetrón, which has exactly the same properties as the electron but a different mass. With it he created a new hydrogen atom in which there is not an electron in the shell but precisely a Košicetrón. What mass $m_{\mathrm{K}}$, in units of the electron mass $m_{\mathrm{e}}$, must the Košicetrón have so that the new Lyman-$\alpha$ line has the wavelength of the original Balmer-$\alpha$ line? To what wavelength does the new Balmer-$\alpha$ line shift? Is this line still visible to the eye?

To refresh your memory: the Lyman $\alpha$ line is the transition of the electron in the hydrogen atom from the second to the first level ($2 \to 1$), and the Balmer $\alpha$ line is the transition of the electron in the hydrogen atom from the third to the second energy level ($3 \to 2$). The wavelengths themselves are
$$\lambda_{\mathrm{L\alpha}} = 121.567\ \mathrm{nm}\,, \qquad \lambda_{\mathrm{B\alpha}} = 656.279\ \mathrm{nm}\,, \qquad \text{(T6.1)}$$
for the Lyman-$\alpha$ and Balmer-$\alpha$ lines, respectively. For the calculation you will need the Rydberg formula. If you do not know it, you can derive it from the assumption that the electron, or the Košicetrón, orbits a stationary proton on a stable circular orbit and that the angular momentum is quantised:
$$L = n\hbar\,, \qquad \text{(T6.2)}$$
where $\hbar = h/2\pi$ is the reduced Planck constant and $n$ is the principal quantum number, the number of the level.

Lyman vs Balmer (80 b)

Jeden nadaný astrofyzik si počas štúdií veľmi obľúbil Johanna Jakoba Balmera, ale zato sa mu znepáčil Theodore Lyman IV. Preto sa rozhodol, že vytvorí hypotetickú časticu Košicetrón, ktorá má úplne rovnaké vlastnosti ako elektrón, ale má inú hmotnosť. Pomocou nej vytvoril nový atóm vodíka, kde v obale nie je elektrón, ale práve Košicetrón. Akú hmotnosť $m_{\mathrm{K}}$ musí mať Košicetrón, v hmotnostiach elektrónu $m_{\mathrm{e}}$, aby nová čiara Lyman-$\alpha$ mala vlnovú dĺžku ako pôvodná čiara Balmer-$\alpha$? Na akú vlnovú dĺžku sa posunie nová čiara Balmer-$\alpha$? Je táto čiara stále okom viditeľná?

Pre občerstvenie pamäte, Lymanova čiara $\alpha$ je prechod elektrónu v atóme vodíka z druhej na prvú hladinu ($2 \to 1$) a Balmerova čiara $\alpha$ je prechod elektrónu v atóme vodíka z tretej na druhú energetickú hladinu ($3 \to 2$). Samotné hodnoty vlnových dĺžok sú
$$\lambda_{\mathrm{L\alpha}} = 121{,}567\ \mathrm{nm}\,, \qquad \lambda_{\mathrm{B\alpha}} = 656{,}279\ \mathrm{nm}\,, \qquad \text{(T6.1)}$$
pre Lyman-$\alpha$, respektíve Balmer-$\alpha$ čiaru. Pre výpočet budete potrebovať Rydbergov vzorec. Ak ho nepoznáte, viete si ho odvodiť z predpokladu, že elektrón, respektíve Košicetrón, obieha okolo nehybného protónu po stabilnej kruhovej dráhe a moment hybnosti podlieha kvantovaniu
$$L = n\hbar\,, \qquad \text{(T6.2)}$$
kde $\hbar = h/2\pi$ je redukovaná Plancková konštanta a $n$ je hlavné kvantové číslo, číslo hladiny.

problems.problem:
A mountain on Mars (120 points)

A probe orbiting Mars on a polar orbit at a height $h = 357$ km found that the longest shadow during the year cast by the mountain Apollinaris at true noon has a length of as much as 119 km. The length of this shadow was measured from the edge of the mountain, which has a diameter of 33 km. At the time when the probe recorded the length of the shadow, we observed from the Earth how this probe emerged from behind the disc of Mars just at the moment when it was exactly above the pole of Mars. Mars was then in opposition with respect to the Earth, and the place from which we observed lay in the plane of the ecliptic. From this information determine the greatest height at the centre of Apollinaris, if it is located at areographic latitude $62^\circ 18'$ S and areographic longitude $175^\circ 45'$ E. We assume that Mars lies in the plane of the ecliptic and that the orbits of Mars and the Earth are circular.

problems.problem:
Spots in the eye (120 points)

On the healthy retina of the human eye there is a pair of almost opposite regions: the blind spot and the yellow spot. The blind spot is the place through which the optic nerve is led from the inside of the eye to the brain, which means that there are no photosensitive cells at this place. The yellow spot, on the contrary, is the place with the highest density of cones, which are capable of colour vision. The yellow spot lies exactly opposite the eye lens and is used in direct vision. In this problem we look more closely at the location and size of these regions.

Fig. T8.1: Diagram of the eye.

David was preparing for the Astronomy Olympiad. He was observing with one eye (the other one closed) the star $\zeta$ Oph (RA $16^{\mathrm{h}}\,37^{\mathrm{min}}\,10^{\mathrm{s}}$, Dec $-10^\circ\,34'\,1''$) by direct vision. (He did not use the trick of averted vision for seeing fainter objects.) An aeroplane flew in front of the observed star at a distance of 12 km from him. A moment later, at the moment when the aeroplane passes in front of the star $\sigma$ Sgr (RA $18^{\mathrm{h}}\,55^{\mathrm{min}}\,49^{\mathrm{s}}$, Dec $-26^\circ\,17'\,50''$), he stops seeing it for a while, and it reappears after 13.2 s.

(a) [60 points] Compute the diameter of the blind spot in mm.

(b) [60 points] Compute the distance between the blind spot and the yellow spot in mm.

The human eye is filled with a liquid (the vitreous body) with refractive index 1.336. Light enters it through the lens, which we assume to be thin and imaging ideally. It concentrates parallel rays to a point on the spherical retina at the back of the eye. The radius of curvature of the retina is 10.5 mm and its centre is at the centre of the lens. We consider the blind spot and the yellow spot to be perfectly circular, and by their distance we mean the distance of their centres.

You will need the speed of the aeroplane, 850 km h$^{-1}$; for simplicity assume that the whole observation takes place near the zenith (the star $\zeta$ Oph is exactly at the zenith and the eye is pointed directly at it during the whole observation), that the aeroplane is a point source of light, passes exactly through the centre of the blind spot and does not change its distance from David.

problems.problem:
Extinction of the dinosaurs 2 (160 points)

In the regional round we took the physical radius of a soot particle $r_{\mathrm{s}}$ to be equal to the radius with which the particle scatters light, which is intuitively logical, but in reality, because of the wave nature of light, this need not be so. The effective radius of a particle for interaction with light, $r_{\mathrm{ef}}$, may differ from $r_{\mathrm{s}}$ depending on the wavelength $\lambda$.

If we take this fact into account, the relation for the perpendicular projection of the surface of a soot particle will be $\pi r_{\mathrm{ef}}^2$, and for its actual volume $\frac{4}{3}\pi r_{\mathrm{s}}^3$. The general result from the regional round will take the alternative form:
$$I_{\mathrm{surface}} = I_0\exp\!\left(-\frac{3M r_{\mathrm{ef}}^2}{16\pi R_\oplus^2\rho_{\mathrm{s}} r_{\mathrm{s}}^3}\right)\,. \qquad \text{(T9.1)}$$

This equation describes the attenuation of direct (unscattered) light on its way from the top of the atmosphere ($I_0$) to the Earth's surface ($I_{\mathrm{surface}}$). In the equation, $M = 3\cdot10^{11}$ kg is the total mass of soot (homogeneously dispersed in the atmosphere), $\rho_{\mathrm{s}} = 2000\ \mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$ is the density of each soot particle and $R_\oplus$ is the radius of the Earth.

Since in this problem we shall deal with the dependence of $r_{\mathrm{ef}}$ and of various radiant fluxes on $\lambda$, instead of the radiant flux over the whole spectrum, previously denoted by the letter $I$ [$\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}}$], we shall use the quantity spectral intensity $J(\lambda)$ [$\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}\,nm^{-1}}$], which expresses $I$ in a unit interval of wavelengths $[\lambda, \lambda + 1\ \mathrm{nm}]$. Analogously, $J_{\mathrm{surface}}(\lambda)$ will be the value of the spectral intensity at the Earth's surface and $J_0(\lambda)$ its value incident on the top of the atmosphere. We shall compute the attenuation of $J$ in the same way as that of $I$, i.e. by the exponential relation (T9.1), taking $r_{\mathrm{ef}}(\lambda)$ into account.

There are two scattering regimes: the Rayleigh and the Mie regime.
- Rayleigh scattering ($r_{\mathrm{s}} \ll \lambda$): $r_{\mathrm{ef}}$ changes strongly with $\lambda$ (more precisely with the ratio of $r_{\mathrm{s}}$ and $\lambda$).
- Mie scattering ($r_{\mathrm{s}} \gtrsim \lambda$): $r_{\mathrm{ef}} \approx r_{\mathrm{s}}$, independently of $\lambda$.

You met the strong case of Mie scattering where $r_{\mathrm{s}} \gg \lambda$ in the regional round, where soot particles with radius $r_{\mathrm{s}} = 3000$ nm scattered visible light with $\lambda$ in the range 400 nm – 700 nm.

Both scattering regimes can be seen in the decadic log-log graph T9.2i (the curve on the left), where the horizontal axis shows the so-called relative frequency, defined as $2\pi r_{\mathrm{s}}/\lambda$, and the vertical axis the so-called relative surface, defined as $(r_{\mathrm{ef}}/r_{\mathrm{s}})^2$. Throughout the problem you may approximate Mie scattering in your calculations by its asymptote for $r_{\mathrm{s}} \gg \lambda$, and you may take as the boundary between the Rayleigh and the Mie regimes the intersection of their asymptotes visible in the graph.

Fig. T9.2: Graphs needed for solving the problem: (i) log-log curve for the scattering regimes for different values of the relative frequency $2\pi r_{\mathrm{s}}/\lambda$; (ii) spectral reflectance of different surfaces in the visible and infrared parts of the spectrum.

Tasks

(a) [15 points] Mark the positions of particles with radii $r_{\mathrm{s}} = 30$ nm, 300 nm, 3000 nm on the curve in graph T9.2i (left) for visible light with $\lambda = 550$ nm. It is enough to sketch the curve very schematically and to mark clearly the numerical values of the coordinates (e.g. do not worry whether in the wavy part of the curve the point lies on a crest or in a trough). Into which regimes do these points fall?

(b) [40 points] From the given graph (Fig. T9.2i) find the functional relation for the effective radius in the Rayleigh regime in the form
$$r_{\mathrm{ef}}(\lambda, r_{\mathrm{s}}) = C r_{\mathrm{s}}^{A}\lambda^{B} \qquad \text{(T9.2)}$$
and determine the numerical values of $A$, $B$, $C$. What is the physical dimension of $C$? For the calculations in the following parts please use the numerical values $A = 3$, $B = -2$, $C = 125$. To obtain points for this part it is necessary to show the procedure clearly.

(c) [25 points] Derive the spectral intensity $J_0(\lambda)$ that falls on the top of the Earth's atmosphere from the Sun. Evaluate it at the wavelengths $\lambda = 400$ nm, 500 nm, 600 nm, 700 nm.

You may find useful Planck's law for the spectral intensity of the surface of the Sun as a black body in the form:
$$J_\odot(\lambda) = 10^{-9}\cdot\frac{8\pi hc^2}{\lambda^5}\,\frac{1}{\exp\!\left(\frac{hc}{\lambda k_{\mathrm{B}} T_\odot}\right) - 1}\,, \qquad \text{(T9.3)}$$
where $h$ is the Planck constant, $c$ is the speed of light in vacuum, $k_{\mathrm{B}}$ is the Boltzmann constant and $T_\odot$ is the effective surface temperature of the Sun. $J_\odot(\lambda)$ is in units of $\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}\,nm^{-1}}$ (but $\lambda$ as such is still in metres!).

Graph T9.2ii (right) shows the spectral reflectance $\mathcal{R}(\lambda)$, i.e. the ratio of reflected to incoming radiation, for different types of surface: plants ("vegetation") and soil ("soil"), in the visible and infrared parts of the spectrum. To solve the following part use the relation for Rayleigh scattering from part (b).

(d) [70 points] If all the spherical soot particles in the atmosphere have the same value of $r_{\mathrm{s}}$, either 30 nm, or 300 nm, or 3000 nm, compute at the wavelengths of the previous part the following quantities (i.e. all 12 combinations):
- the spectral intensity of unscattered light at the Earth's surface absorbed by plants, $J_{\mathrm{absorb}}$ [$\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}\,nm^{-1}}$],
- the ratio of the light that gets from the top of the atmosphere to the Earth's surface, $J_{\mathrm{surface}}/J_0$.

Interpret the trends found as functions of $r_{\mathrm{s}}$ and $\lambda$, above all for $J_{\mathrm{surface}}/J_0$. Assume that the Sun is at the zenith and that nothing else in the atmosphere apart from the mentioned soot particles interacts with the light.

To obtain partial points, take care to explain your procedure and assumptions thoroughly; we also recommend deriving the general relations. We recommend giving the final numerical results of (d) in a clear table with the columns $r_{\mathrm{s}}$, $\lambda$, relative frequency, scattering regime, $J_{\mathrm{surface}}/J_0$, $J_{\mathrm{absorb}}$, in suitable units.

(e) [10 points] Even with a correct procedure it is unlikely that your table will correspond exactly to the one in the official solution. Roughly what average error do you expect, assuming that you have the correct procedure, and where does this error come from?

Extinkcia dinosaurov 2 (160 b)

V regionálnom kole sme fyzický polomer častice sadze $r_{\mathrm{s}}$ považovali za rovný polomeru s akým častica rozptyľuje svetlo, čo je intuitívne logické, no v skutočnosti to tak v dôsledku vlnovej povahy svetla nemusí byť. $$I_{\mathrm{povrch}} = I_0\exp\!\left(-\frac{3M r_{\mathrm{ef}}^2}{16\pi R_\oplus^2\rho_{\mathrm{s}} r_{\mathrm{s}}^3}\right)\,. \qquad \text{(T9.1)}$$

Táto rovnica popisuje útlm priameho (nerozptýleného) svetla pri prechode z vrchu atmosféry ($I_0$) na zemský povrch ($I_{\mathrm{povrch}}$). V rovnici je $M = 3\cdot10^{11}$ kg celková hmotnosť sadzí (homogénne rozptýlených v atmosfére), $\rho_{\mathrm{s}} = 2000\ \mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$ hustota každej častice sadze a $R_\oplus$ polomer Zeme.

Keďže sa v tejto úlohe budeme zaoberať závislosťou $r_{\mathrm{ef}}$ a rôznych žiarivých tokov na $\lambda$, namiesto žiarivého toku v celom spektre, predtým značenom písmenom $I$ [$\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}}$], tak budeme používať veličinu spektrálna intenzita $J(\lambda)$ [$\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}\,nm^{-1}}$], ktorá vyjadruje $I$ v jednotkovom intervale vlnových dĺžok $[\lambda, \lambda + 1\ \mathrm{nm}]$. Analogicky, $J_{\mathrm{povrch}}(\lambda)$ bude hodnota spektrálnej intenzity na povrchu Zeme a $J_0(\lambda)$ jej hodnota dopadajúca na vrch atmosféry. Útlm $J$ budeme počítať rovnako ako $I$, teda podľa exponenciálneho vzťahu (T9.1), s prihliadnutím na $r_{\mathrm{ef}}(\lambda)$.

Existujú dva režimy rozptylu: Rayleigho a Mieov režim.
- Rayleigho rozptyl ($r_{\mathrm{s}} \ll \lambda$): $r_{\mathrm{ef}}$ sa výrazne mení s $\lambda$ (presnejšie s pomerom $r_{\mathrm{s}}$ a $\lambda$).
- Mieov rozptyl ($r_{\mathrm{s}} \gtrsim \lambda$): $r_{\mathrm{ef}} \approx r_{\mathrm{s}}$, nezávisle na $\lambda$.

So silným prípadom Mieovho rozptylu kde $r_{\mathrm{s}} \gg \lambda$ ste sa stretli v RK, kde spôsobovali častice sadze s polomerom $r_{\mathrm{s}} = 3000$ nm rozptyl viditeľného svetla s $\lambda$ v rozmedzí 400 nm - 700 nm.

Oba režimy rozptylu vidno na dekadicky logaritmickom grafe T9.2i (krivka vľavo), kde na vodorovnej osi je tzv. relatívna frekvencia, definovaná ako $2\pi r_{\mathrm{s}}/\lambda$, a na zvislej osi je tzv. relatívny povrch, definovaný ako $(r_{\mathrm{ef}}/r_{\mathrm{s}})^2$. V celej úlohe budete môcť vo výpočtoch aproximovať Mieov rozptyl jeho asymptotou pre $r_{\mathrm{s}} \gg \lambda$, a za hranicu medzi Rayleigho a Mieovým režimom môžete považovať priesečník ich asymptót viditeľný na grafe.

Obr. T9.2: Grafy potrebné na vypracovanie úlohy: (i) log-log krivka pre režimy rozptylu pre rôzne hodnoty relatívnej frekvencie $2\pi r_{\mathrm{s}}/\lambda$; (ii) spektrálna reflektancia pre rôzne povrchy vo viditeľnej a infračervenej oblasti spektra. Prevzaté 20.4.2025 z en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mie_scattering a mathworks.com (help/images/spectral-indices).

Úlohy

(a) [15 b] Vyznačte polohy častíc s polomermi $r_{\mathrm{s}} = 30$ nm, 300 nm, 3000 nm na krivke na grafe T9.2i (vľavo) pre viditeľné svetlo s $\lambda = 550$ nm. Stačí len veľmi schematicky načrtnúť krivku a jasne vyznačiť číselné hodnoty súradníc (napr. netrápte sa či v tej vlnitej časti krivky leží bod na vrchu či v údolí). Do ktorých režimov tieto body spadajú?

(b) [40 b] Z daného grafu (obr. T9.2i) nájdite funkčný vzťah pre efektívny polomer v Rayleigho režime v tvare
$$r_{\mathrm{ef}}(\lambda, r_{\mathrm{s}}) = C r_{\mathrm{s}}^{A}\lambda^{B} \qquad \text{(T9.2)}$$
a určte číselné hodnoty $A$, $B$, $C$. Aký je fyzikálny rozmer $C$? Pre výpočty v ďalších úlohách prosím použite číselné hodnoty $A = 3$, $B = -2$, $C = 125$. Na získanie bodov za túto úlohu je nutné jasne ukázať postup.

(c) [25 b] Odvoďte spektrálnu intenzitu $J_0(\lambda)$ ktorá dopadá na vrchol zemskej atmosféry zo Slnka. Vyčíslite na vlnových dĺžkach $\lambda = 400$ nm, 500 nm, 600 nm, 700 nm.

Môže sa vám hodiť Planckov zákon pre spektrálnu intenzitu povrchu Slnka ako absolútne čierneho telesa (AČT) v tvare:
$$J_\odot(\lambda) = 10^{-9}\cdot\frac{8\pi hc^2}{\lambda^5}\,\frac{1}{\exp\!\left(\frac{hc}{\lambda k_{\mathrm{B}} T_\odot}\right) - 1}\,, \qquad \text{(T9.3)}$$
kde $h$ je Planckova konštanta, $c$ je rýchlosť svetla vo vákuu, $k_{\mathrm{B}}$ je Boltzmannova konštanta a $T_\odot$ je efektívna povrchová teplota Slnka. $J_\odot(\lambda)$ je v jednotkách $\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}\,nm^{-1}}$ (ale $\lambda$ ako také je stále v metroch!)

Graf T9.2ii (vpravo) zobrazuje spektrálnu reflektanciu $\mathcal{R}(\lambda)$, teda pomer odrazeného k prichádzajúcemu žiareniu, pre rôzne typy povrchu: rastliny („vegetation“) a zeminu („soil“), vo viditeľnej a infračervenej oblasti spektra. Na riešenie nasledujúcej úlohy využite vzťah pre Rayleighov rozptyl z úlohy (b).

(d) [70 b] Ak majú všetky sférické častice sadze v atmosfére rovnaké hodnoty $r_{\mathrm{s}}$, buď 30 nm alebo 300 nm, alebo 3000 nm, vypočítajte na vlnových dĺžkach z predošlej úlohy tieto veličiny (t.j. všetkých 12 kombinácií):
- spektrálnu intenzitu nerozptýleného svetla na povrchu Zeme pohlcovaného rastlinami $J_{\mathrm{absorb}}$ [$\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}\,nm^{-1}}$],
- pomer svetla, ktoré sa dostane z vrchu atmosféry na povrch Zeme $J_{\mathrm{povrch}}/J_0$.

Interpretujte nájdené trendy v závislosti od $r_{\mathrm{s}}$ a $\lambda$, predovšetkým pre $J_{\mathrm{povrch}}/J_0$. Uvažujte, že Slnko je v zenite, a že už nič iné v atmosfére, okrem zmienených častíc sadze, so svetlom neinteraguje.

Pre získanie čiastkových bodov dbajte na dôkladné vysvetlenie svojho postupu a predpokladov, odporúčame odvodiť aj všeobecné vzťahy. Konečné numerické výsledky (d) odporúčame uviesť v prehľadnej tabuľke so stĺpcami $r_{\mathrm{s}}$, $\lambda$, relatívna frekvencia, režim rozpytlu, $J_{\mathrm{povrch}}/J_0$, $J_{\mathrm{absorb}}$, vo vhodných jednotkách.

(e) [10 b] Aj pri správnom postupe je nepravdepodobné, že vaša tabuľka bude presne zodpovedať tej v oficiálnom riešení. Asi akú priemernú chybu očakávate za predpokladu, že máte správny postup a odkiaľ táto chyba pochádza?

problems.problem:
Retrograde Mars (222 points)

Rado was browsing reliable internet sources and learned that the retrograde motion of the planets and their position at a given time have an extraordinary influence on drawing up a horoscope. This interested him greatly, but he did not know how to go about it. Will you help Rado prepare for his future?

In this problem consider the orbits of the Earth and Mars to be circles which, together with the Sun, lie in one plane. Use the data from the constants sheet. For the radii of the orbits $r_\oplus$, $r_{\mathrm{Mars}}$ use the values of their semi-major axes, i.e. $r_\oplus \equiv a_\oplus$, $r_{\mathrm{Mars}} \equiv a_{\mathrm{Mars}}$. In the problem you may decide to use the assumption that Mars does not move around the Sun, i.e. that it is fixed in space at the distance $r_{\mathrm{Mars}}$ from the Sun; however, for each part computed with this assumption you will obtain at most 20 % of the points.

(a) [60 points] During what time $\Delta t$ does the planet Mars, viewed from the Earth, move apparently retrograde (in the opposite direction) on the sky among the stars?

(b) [30 points] Determine the distance $R$ between Mars and the Earth at the end of the retrograde motion of Mars (at the moment of apparent stopping as seen from the Earth). If you did not manage to compute $\Delta t$ in part (a), use the value $\Delta t = 100$ days.

(c) [30 points] Compute the change of the ecliptic longitude of Mars $\Delta\lambda$ during the time $\Delta t$, i.e. between the beginning and the end of the retrograde motion. If you did not manage to determine $\Delta t$ in part (a), use the value $\Delta t = 100$ days.

(d) [30 points] Find the elongation of Mars $\varepsilon$ at the end of the retrograde motion. If you did not manage to compute $\Delta t$ in part (a), use the value $\Delta t = 100$ days.

(e) [50 points] Using the ratio of the radii of the orbits of Mars and the Earth $k := r_{\mathrm{Mars}}/r_\oplus$ and the orbital period of the Earth around the Sun $P_\oplus = 1\ \text{year} = 365.25$ days, write the simplest possible general expressions for the quantities $\Delta t$, $R$, $\varepsilon$ that you computed in parts (a), (b), (d).

(f) [20 points] What values do the quantities $\Delta t$, $R$, $\varepsilon$ take for $k$ close to zero and to infinity?

Help: The following trigonometric identities for arbitrary angles $\alpha$, $\beta$ may be useful:
- $\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1$,
- $\sin(\alpha-\beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta - \cos\alpha\sin\beta$,
- $\cos(\alpha-\beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta$.

(g) [2 points] On the basis of your results determine what Rado's sign is. Since we are not yet competing at the international level, we give you a choice from the options:
i. Taurus,
ii. Mečiar,
iii. Big Dipper.

Retrográdny Mars (222 b)

Rado si prezeral spoľahlivé internetové zdroje a dozvedel sa, že retrográdny pohyb planét a ich umiestnenie v danom čase má mimoriadny vplyv na zostavenie horoskopu. To ho veľmi zaujalo, no nevedel, ako na to. Pomôžete Radovi pripraviť sa na jeho budúcnosť?

V tejto úlohe považujte dráhy Zeme a Marsu za kružnice, ktoré spolu so Slnkom ležia v jednej rovine. Použite údaje z konštantovníka. Pre polomery dráh $r_\oplus$, $r_♂$ použite hodnoty ich veľkých polos, teda $r_\oplus \equiv a_\oplus$, $r_♂ \equiv a_♂$. V príklade sa môžete rozhodnúť použiť predpoklad, že sa Mars nepohybuje okolo Slnka, teda je pevne umiestnený v priestore vo vzdialenosti $r_♂$ od Slnka, avšak za každé podzadanie spočítané s týmto predpokladom získate maximálne 20 % bodov.

(a) [60 b] Počas akého času $\Delta t$ sa planéta Mars pri pohľade zo Zeme pohybuje po oblohe medzi hviezdami zdanlivo retrográdne (opačným smerom)?

(b) [30 b] Určte vzdialenosť $R$ Marsu a Zeme na konci retrográdneho pohybu Marsu (v momente zdanlivého zastavenia pri pohľade zo Zeme). Ak sa vám v podzadaní (a) nepodarilo vypočítať $\Delta t$, použite hodnotu $\Delta t = 100$ dní.

(c) [30 b] Vypočítajte zmenu ekliptikálnej dĺžky Marsu $\Delta\lambda$ počas času $\Delta t$, teda medzi začiatkom a koncom retrográdneho pohybu. Ak sa vám v podzadaní (a) nepodarilo určiť $\Delta t$, použite hodnotu $\Delta t = 100$ dní.

(d) [30 b] Zistite elongáciu Marsu $\varepsilon$ na konci retrográdneho pohybu. Ak sa vám v podzadaní (a) nepodarilo vypočítať $\Delta t$, použite hodnotu $\Delta t = 100$ dní.

(e) [50 b] Pomocou pomeru polomerov dráh Marsu a Zeme $k := r_♂/r_\oplus$ a obežnej doby Zeme okolo Slnka $P_\oplus = 1\ \text{rok} = 365{,}25$ dní napíšte čo najjednoduchšie všeobecné vyjadrenia veličín $\Delta t$, $R$, $\varepsilon$, ktoré ste vypočítali v podzadaniach (a), (b), (d).

(f) [20 b] Aké hodnoty nadobúdajú veličiny $\Delta t$, $R$, $\varepsilon$ pre $k$ blízke nule a nekonečnu?

Pomôcka: Môžu sa vám hodiť nasledovné trigonometrické identity pre ľubovoľné uhly $\alpha$, $\beta$;
- $\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1$,
- $\sin(\alpha-\beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta - \cos\alpha\sin\beta$,
- $\cos(\alpha-\beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta$.

(g) [2 b] Na základe vašich výsledkov určte, aké má Rado znamenie. Keďže ešte nesúťažíme na medzinárodnej úrovni, dáme vám na výber z možností:
i. Býk,
ii. Mečiar,
iii. Veľký voz.

An expedition to the 2024 total solar eclipse in America was caught by unfavourable weather: cloud cover was forecast for the day of the eclipse over most of Texas (where they had originally planned to observe). They therefore decided to set off north in the night before the eclipse, towards Arkansas, in the hope of reaching a place with good observing conditions.

Of course, to be able to observe the total eclipse they had to stay within the path of totality. The position within the path itself also matters, because the eclipse is longest at its centre.

While driving towards the longed-for cloudless place, the question arose whether the dependence of the duration of the total eclipse on the distance from the centre of the path of totality can be determined in some simple way. In the real case this is not very simple, but if we make certain simplifications we can derive a dependence that describes reality quite well.

problems.problem:
A distant galaxy (335 points)

Imagine that you are observing a distant galaxy. But how distant, actually? That is the question you will try to answer in this problem. In the Universe there are several ways of estimating distances. Estimating is perhaps a better description than measuring, because each method is typically burdened by considerable errors. Among the methods applicable to distant galaxies (galaxies outside the Local Group of galaxies) are standard candles, the Tully–Fisher relation and observations of galactic megamasers ("mega" as in strong, "maser" as in microwave laser). The data and the particular galaxy are invented, but the individual quantities have typical, observable values. The individual methods are of course slightly simplified; in particular, the data are presented to you already cleaned of most systematic errors.

Planetary nebula luminosity function (PNLF)

The first method uses photometry of planetary nebulae, as described in the article Extragalactic Distances from Planetary Nebulae (https://arxiv.org/pdf/astro-ph/0301279). Its great advantage is that the whole measurement can be done with just a pair of photographs. One photograph (narrow-band) is taken in a typical spectral line in which planetary nebulae shine. Usually this is the [O III] line, i.e. the forbidden line of doubly ionised oxygen. The second photograph is taken in the continuum. The continuum image is then subtracted from the narrow-band image. The details of the measurement are not important; what is essential, however, is that planetary nebulae are not standard candles in themselves (an object or phenomenon with a radiated energy that we know or can determine precisely). The maximum theoretical luminosity of a planetary nebula, however, is a standard candle. But how can this maximum theoretical luminosity be revealed? It was found empirically that if we make a histogram of the number of planetary nebulae with particular values of the absolute luminosity $M$, the graph shows the functional dependence
$$N(M) \propto e^{0.307M}\cdot\left(1 - e^{3(M_{\mathrm{PNLF}} - M)}\right)\,. \qquad \text{(D2.1)}$$

Here $M_{\mathrm{PNLF}} = -4.48$ mag is the absolute magnitude of the theoretically brightest planetary nebula. This value seems to be universal for all galaxies. So if we are able to fit the value of the apparent magnitude $m_{\mathrm{PNLF}}$ corresponding to the theoretically maximum absolute magnitude, we shall be able to calculate the distance of the galaxy.

Task 1 [65 points] Draw a graph in which you plot the data from Table D2.1. The horizontal axis represents the observed magnitude and the vertical axis represents the decimal logarithm of the number of planetary nebulae with the given magnitude $m \pm 0.05$ mag. Do not forget to plot the error bars correctly. Make a freehand fit to the data. You may take inspiration from the illustrative figure D2.1. Read off the value of the magnitude $m_{\mathrm{PNLF}}$ at which your fit passes through the count value 1. Do not forget to give the uncertainty of this result, $\sigma_{m_{\mathrm{PNLF}}}$. On the basis of this result compute the distance $d_{\mathrm{PNLF}}$ to the observed galaxy together with the expected measurement error $\sigma_{d_{\mathrm{PNLF}}}$. Your final graph, and above all the fit, should look similar to the illustrative sketch D2.1.

Globular cluster luminosity function (GCLF)

As with planetary nebulae, we cannot regard globular clusters as standard candles either. It was found experimentally, however, that when we do statistics on known distances, we find that the most probable absolute luminosity equals $M_{\mathrm{GCLF}} = -7.56$ mag, sometimes also denoted TOM, from the English "Turn Over Magnitude". This absolute luminosity already shows sufficient regularity for us to speak of it as a standard candle, as described in the article The Globular Cluster Luminosity Function: New Progress in Understanding an Old Distance Indicator (https://arxiv.org/pdf/astro-ph/0304318).

Task 2 [30 points] From the supplied graph D2.4 read off the value $m_{\mathrm{GCLF}}$, i.e. the value of the most probable magnitude. Do not forget to give the uncertainty of this result, $\sigma_{m_{\mathrm{GCLF}}}$. Compute the distance $d_{\mathrm{GCLF}}$ to the observed galaxy on the basis of this result, together with the expected measurement error $\sigma_{d_{\mathrm{GCLF}}}$.

Tully–Fisher relation

Another way of finding the distance to distant galaxies is based on measuring the rotational velocity $v_{\mathrm{T-F}}$ of the galaxy's disc. This method was first proposed in the article A new method of determining distances to galaxies (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1977A&A....54..661T) by the pair of authors R. Brent Tully and J. Richard Fisher, after whom the method is still named. They found empirically that the luminosity of a galaxy $L$ shows the approximate dependence $L \propto v_{\mathrm{T-F}}^4$. Of course it is still necessary to convert to magnitudes and to calibrate the whole relation correctly. We shall use the expression in the form
$$m - M = 21.1 + 3.7\cdot\log_{10}\!\left(v_{\mathrm{T-F}}\left[\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}\right]\right)\,. \qquad \text{(D2.2)}$$

In reality we cannot measure the rotational velocity directly. We can, however, measure the splitting of spectral lines caused by this rotation. Such a split spectrum then looks as in the illustrative sketch D2.2. All the spectra (Figures D2.5, D2.6, D2.7, D2.8, D2.9) are already corrected for the proper motion of the galaxy.

The laboratory values of the observed wavelengths are given in Table D2.2.

At the same time, do not forget to correct the measurements for the inclination of the galaxy. This is a quantity that is really extremely difficult to estimate, because often we can only start from the photograph of the galaxy in Figure D2.10 and the assumption that the galaxy is in reality circular. Do not forget to give the inclination $i$ you obtain together with its error $\sigma_i$.

From this splitting, which is caused exclusively by the Doppler shift, find the rotational velocity of the given galaxy $v_{\mathrm{T-F}}$ together with an estimate of the error $\sigma_{v_{\mathrm{T-F}}}$. Use this velocity, together with the Tully–Fisher relation, to compute the distance of the given galaxy $d_{\mathrm{T-F}}$ together with an estimate of the error $\sigma_{d_{\mathrm{T-F}}}$.

Megamaser

A very interesting way of measuring distances is to use measurements of spectra emitted in the radio region around active galactic nuclei, as described in the article The megamaser cosmology project. I. Very long baseline interferometric observations of UGC 3789 (https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1088/0004-637X/695/1/287). Matter accreting onto the supermassive black hole at the centre of such a galaxy is in an excited state (so-called pumping takes place), and so it is able to radiate into its surroundings like a huge microwave laser. The radiated energy is enormous, so the maser is easy to detect. At the same time its emission line is narrow and thus easily recognisable. Most often emission is observed in the 18 cm OH line or the 1.35 cm $\mathrm{H_2O}$ line. From this spectrum we can find the velocity of the matter around the black hole, and if we measure this spectrum for different positions within the centre of the galaxy, also the size of the cloud of this material. From repeated observations we can find the acceleration of the matter falling onto the black hole, $a = 15.5\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,yr^{-1}}$. Combining simple relations we arrive at the resulting relation for the distance of the observed galaxy
$$d_{\mathrm{MM}}[\mathrm{m}] = \frac{\left(v_{\mathrm{MM}}\left[\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\right]\right)^2}{a\left[\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}\right]\cdot\Delta\Theta[\mathrm{rad}]}\,. \qquad \text{(D2.3)}$$

Here $v_{\mathrm{MM}}$ is the maximum orbital velocity and $\Delta\Theta$ is the angular size. The values measured for the galaxy we are investigating are in Table D2.3.

The vertical axis represents the measured rotational velocity at the given place. Make a combined fit: freehand outside the disc and linear with a ruler within the disc; you may take inspiration from sketch D2.3. Read off the values of the velocity $v_{\mathrm{MM}}$ and of the angular size $\Delta\Theta$. Do not forget to give the uncertainties of these results, $\sigma_{v_{\mathrm{MM}}}$ and $\sigma_{\Delta\Theta}$. We leave the particular method to you, but it is important to justify its choice. What, in your opinion, is the resulting value of the distance to the observed galaxy $d$ and its uncertainty $\sigma_d$?

Vzdialená galaxia (335 b)

Predstavte si, že pozorujete vzdialenú galaxiu. Ako ďaleko ale vlastne vzdialenú? To je otázka, na ktorú sa pokúsite v tejto úlohe prísť. Vo vesmíre existuje viacero spôsobov, ako odhadovať vzdialenosti. Odhadovať je asi lepší popis ako merať, pretože každá jedna metóda je typicky zaťažená značnými chybami. Medzi metódy, ktoré sú použiteľné pre vzdialené galaxie (galaxie mimo miestnej skupiny galaxií) patria štandardné sviečky, vzťah Tully-Fisher alebo pozorovanie galaktických megamaserov („mega“ ako silný, „maser“ ako mikrovlnný laser). Údaje a konkrétna galaxia sú vymyslené, ale jednotlivé veličiny majú typické, pozorovateľné hodnoty. Jednotlivé metódy sú samozrejme mierne zjednodušené, najmä sú vám prezentované dáta už očistené o väčšinu systematických chýb.

Funkcia svietivosti pre planetárne hmloviny (PNLF)

Prvá metóda využíva fotometriu planetárnych hmlovín, tak ako je popísaná v článku Extragalactic Distances from Planetary Nebulae (https://arxiv.org/pdf/astro-ph/0301279). Veľkou výhodou je, že sa celé meranie dá vykonať s pomocou iba dvojice fotografií. Jedna fotografia (úzkopásmová) sa vykoná v typickej spektrálnej čiare, v akej svietia planetárne hmloviny. Obvykle je to čiara [O III], teda zakázaná čiara dvakrát ionizovaného kyslíka. Druhá fotografia je vykonaná v kontinuu. Následne sa od úzkopásmovej snímky odčíta snímka v kontinuu. Konkrétnosti merania nie sú dôležité, zásadné ale je, že planetárne hmloviny nie sú samé o sebe štandardné sviečky (objekt alebo jav s vyžarovanou energiou, ktorú poznáme alebo vieme určiť presne). Maximálna teoretická svietivosť planetárnej hmloviny už štandardnou sviečkou je. Ako ale odhaliť túto maximálnu teoretickú svietivosť? Empiricky bolo zistené, že ak si vytvoríme histogram počtu planetárnych hmlovín s konkrétnymi hodnotami absolútnej svietivosti $M$, potom graf vykazuje funkčnú závislosť
$$N(M) \propto e^{0{,}307M}\cdot\left(1 - e^{3(M_{\mathrm{PNLF}} - M)}\right)\,. \qquad \text{(D2.1)}$$

Pričom $M_{\mathrm{PNLF}} = -4{,}48$ mag je absolútna magnitúda teoreticky najjasnejšej planetárnej hmloviny. Táto hodnota sa zdá byť univerzálna pre všetky galaxie. Ak teda budeme schopní nafitovať hodnotu zdanlivej teoreticky maximálne absolútnej magnitúdy $m_{\mathrm{PNLF}}$, potom budeme schopní vypočítať jej vzdialenosť.

Úloha 1 [65 b] Narysujte graf, do ktorého vynesiete dáta z tabuľky D2.1. Vodorovná os predstavuje pozorovanú magnitúdu a vertikálna os predstavuje desiatkový logaritmus množstva planetárnych hmlovín s danou magnitúdou $m \pm 0{,}05$ mag. Nezabudnite aj správne vyniesť chybové úsečky (error bary). Vykonajte fit voľnou rukou na dátach. Môžete sa inšpirovať ilustračným obrázkom D2.1. Odčítajte hodnotu magnitúdy $m_{\mathrm{PNLF}}$ na ktorej váš fit prechádza hodnotou početnosti 1. Nezabudnite uviesť aj neistotu tohto výsledku $\sigma_{m_{\mathrm{PNLF}}}$. Na základe tohto výsledku vypočítajte vzdialenosť $d_{\mathrm{PNLF}}$ ku pozorovanej galaxii aj s predpokladanou chybou merania $\sigma_{d_{\mathrm{PNLF}}}$. Funkcia svietivosti pre guľové hviezdokopy (GCLF)

Obdobne ako pri planetárnych hmlovinách, tak aj pri guľových hviezdokopách nemôžeme o nich uvažovať ako o štandardných sviečkach. Experimentálne sa ale zistilo, že keď urobíme štatistiku na známych vzdialenostiach, zistíme, že najpravdepodobnejšia absolútna svietivosť je rovná hodnote $M_{\mathrm{GCLF}} = -7{,}56$ mag. Niekedy označovaná aj ako TOM, z anglického „Turn Over Magnitude“. Práve táto absolútna svietivosť už vykazuje dostatočnú regularitu, aby sme o nej mohli hovoriť ako o štandardnej sviečke, tak ako je popísané v článku The Globular Cluster Luminosity Function: New Progress in Understanding an Old Distance Indicator (https://arxiv.org/pdf/astro-ph/0304318).

Tully-Fisher závislosť

Ďalší spôsob, ako zistiť vzdialenosť k vzdialeným galaxiám, je na základe merania rotačnej rýchlosti $v_{\mathrm{T-F}}$ disku galaxie. Táto metóda bola prvykrát predostrená v článku A new method of determining distances to galaxies (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1977A&A....54..661T) dvojicou autorov R. Brent Tully a J. Richard Fisher, podľa ktorých sa táto metóda dodnes nazýva. Empiricky zistili, že svietivosť galaxie $L$ vykazuje približnú závislosť ako $L \propto v_{\mathrm{T-F}}^4$. Samozrejme, je ešte potrebné prejsť do magnitúd a celý vzťah správne nakalibrovať. My budeme používať výraz v tvare
$$m - M = 21{,}1 + 3{,}7\cdot\log_{10}\!\left(v_{\mathrm{T-F}}\left[\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}\right]\right)\,. \qquad \text{(D2.2)}$$

V realite nevieme zmerať rotačnú rýchlosť priamo. Vieme ale merať rozštiepenie spektrálnych čiar, spôsobené touto rotáciou. Takéto rozštiepené spektrum následne vyzerá ako je na ilustračnom náčrte D2.2. Všetky spektrá (obrázky D2.5, D2.6, D2.7, D2.8, D2.9) sú už opravené o vlastný pohyb galaxie.

Megamaser

Veľmi zaujímavým spôsobom merania vzdialeností je využitie merania spektier vyžarovaných v rádiovej oblasti okolo aktívnych galaktických centier, tak ako je popísané v článku The megamaser cosmology project. I. very long baseline interferometric observations of UGC 3789 (https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1088/0004-637X/695/1/287). Hmota, ktorá sa nabaľuje na supermasívnu čiernu dieru v centre takejto galaxie, sa nachádza vo vybudenom stave (dochádza k tzv. pumping-u) a tak je schopná vyžarovať ako obrovský mikrovlnný laser do okolia. Vyžarovaná energia je obrovská, preto sa maser dá jednoducho zachytiť. Zároveň je jeho emisná čiara úzka a tak ľahko rozoznateľná. Najčastejšie sa pozoruje vyžarovanie na čiare 18 cm OH, alebo 1,35 cm $\mathrm{H_2O}$. Z tohto spektra vieme zistiť rýchlosť hmoty okolo čiernej diery, a ak meriame toto spektrum pre rôzne pozície v rámci centra galaxie, tak aj veľkosť oblaku tohto materiálu. Z opakovaných pozorovaní vieme zistiť zrýchlenie pádu hmoty na čiernu dieru $a = 15{,}5\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,rok^{-1}}$. Kombináciou jednoduchých vzťahov prichádzame k výslednému vzťahu pre vzdialenosť pozorovanej galaxie
$$d_{\mathrm{MM}}[\mathrm{m}] = \frac{\left(v_{\mathrm{MM}}\left[\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\right]\right)^2}{a\left[\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}\right]\cdot\Delta\Theta[\mathrm{rad}]}\,. \qquad \text{(D2.3)}$$

Kde $v_{\mathrm{MM}}$ je maximálna orbitálna rýchlosť a $\Delta\Theta$ je uhlová veľkosť. Namerané hodnoty pre nami vyšetrovanú galaxiu sú v tabuľke D2.3.
